learner_notice: Choose an answer, then submit to see feedback.

items.title: Starting check
items.prompt: A vertical axis has equally spaced labels 1, 10, and 100. Moving one labelled major step changes the value how?

items.title: Guided practice
items.prompt: A linear output-versus-trial display moves from 4 units at trial 2 to 16 units at trial 5. Which calculation finds the slope?

items.title: Less help
items.prompt: On a log-log graph, a straight trend has plotted slope 2. When x increases by a factor of 10, what change in y does that trend predict?
options: y increases by a factor of 10.
y increases by a factor of 100.
items.text_description: Both axes are base-10 logarithmic axes with equally spaced labels 0.1, 1, and 10.

items.title: On your own
items.prompt: A linear graph includes the labelled points (3, 8) and (7, 20). What is the slope?

items.title: Final check
items.prompt: A linear position-versus-time graph shows 18 meters at 6 seconds and 30 meters at 10 seconds. What does its slope represent?
items.text_description: The horizontal axis is time in seconds and the vertical axis is position in meters.

items.title: Changed final check
items.prompt: A semilog graph shows values of 2, 20, and 200 at x = 0, 1, and 2. If the same straight pattern continues, what value is predicted at x = 3?
items.text_description: The vertical axis is base-10 logarithmic; equal vertical display steps represent equal factors of 10.

items.title: Try the scale rule
items.prompt: A logarithmic vertical axis has equally spaced labels 5, 50, and 500. Which operation carries a value one labelled step upward?

items.title: Rebuild the slope rule
items.prompt: A line moves from (2 seconds, 7 meters) to (5 seconds, 19 meters). What slope do you obtain?
items.text_description: The horizontal axis is time in seconds and the vertical axis is position in meters.

items.title: Return to the linear check
items.prompt: A linear drainage graph shows 56 liters at 2 minutes and 32 liters at 8 minutes. What is the slope?
items.text_description: The horizontal axis is time in minutes and the vertical axis is volume in liters.

items.title: Return to the semilog check
items.prompt: A straight pattern on a semilog graph has value 5 at x = 0 and value 50 at x = 1. Which equation represents that same multiplicative pattern?
items.text_description: The vertical axis is base-10 logarithmic. Moving one equal vertical display interval multiplies the value by 10.
